svg.title: Dalampasigan Inn
svg.text: Dalampasigan Inn · plan and camera map
640 sqm · San Juan, La Union · sea west · bright coastal morning
Coordinates in meters. North up. ★ = anchor shot for that space.
B repeats A exactly, translated 4 m north.
Only Kumot changes: natural to indigo.
Upper floor: same six room types and corridor above the guest wing; support rooms above the south block.
Twelve guest rooms total. * = not a catalog piece. Each inset has its own scale bar; north is unchanged.
C6 is drawn over C3 in the room-type inset because the room and camera are exact translations.
Cones show full-frame horizontal direction before crop; their short length is a symbol, not a focus limit.
35mm cone: 54 degrees. 50mm cone: 40 degrees. Read camera height and any downward pitch in the bible.
